title: The Solitary Frequency Deep

features.name: the antenna-stone
features.desc-on-touch: A single upright shaft of slate, weathered into a needle. It hums at a frequency only one voice can match. The sound it makes is yours, alone, specific, unrepeatable.

features.name: the listening pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water so still it seems to hold sound. When you speak into it, only you hear the echo. The depth is yours alone; no other voice has ever found its bottom.

features.name: the wire-cage
features.desc-on-touch: A delicate framework hanging in the air, transparent as breathing. It catches and holds a single frequency—the sound of one person singing to themselves, alone, learning themselves.

features.name: the solitary mark
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph that appears only to one reader. Every person who comes here sees a different symbol—the one that means 'you alone understand this.' It is never the same twice.

features.name: the transmission post
features.desc-on-touch: A hollow tube of weathered wood, broadcasting in a language that has never been spoken aloud. Only the solitary can hear it; the moment a second voice joins, the transmission stops.

inscription: when only one voice sings, every note becomes a prayer to the self that listens back

file.name: Solitary_Frequency_Registry_1982_Field_Recording.mp3
file.note: A capture of a single sustained tone, recorded at this location. The frequency never wavers. Background: absolute silence. No other sound exists in this file.

exits.label: the path rising back to where harmony still exists
a descent into even deeper isolation, past all song
a worn track toward other solitary listeners
a passage where singular voices echo back as themselves
